title: Verifiable Commitment Mechanisms: Formal Precommitment in LLM Behavior

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Clear chain: if LLMs can make and keep verifiable commitments, game-theoretic alignment proposals become practically implementable. Directly bridges formal game theory and practical multi-agent alignment.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: The behavioral test (announce policy, test compliance over 200 requests) is straightforward API-based evaluation. Measuring deviation rate is simple.
